title: Traders
description: Trader stock and barter rates (spec MGT-039/MGT-040, ITM-022/ITM-023, ITM-034). Item prices are items.valueUsd.
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

traders.description: MGT-039: faction traders (Krug markets are not listed here, MGT-040)

faction.description: The employer faction that runs the trader; its standing with the player gates the stock (MGT-039)

locationKind.description: POI type where this trader sells, e.g. city (STR-010 POI types)

stockByStanding.description: MGT-039 stock tiers: basic = Unfriendly (with unfriendlyPriceMarkup) and Neutral; military = added at Friendly; best = added at Trusted; Hostile = no trade. Item IDs only: armoured vehicles and helicopters are vehicles (vehicleTrade, MGT-076), not listed here

krugPremiumRate.description: ITM-022, design 1.0 for tobacco, alcohol, valuables

gearBuyRate.description: ITM-022: share of the trader price a faction trader pays for gear, design draft 0.4

krugGearBuyRate.description: ITM-022: share of the current Krug price a Krug market pays for gear, design draft 0.5

krugPriceFluctuation.description: MGT-040, design draft: once per day by up to 10%, never more than 30% from base (valueUsd)

krugStock.description: MGT-040: the Krug's item list and how each Krug market's own stock is drawn from it (a seeded share rolled once per market)

basic.description: Krug items open at any standing that allows trade; not set (design: not stated)

better.description: Better Krug items: in a market's stock, bought only at reputation with the Krug >= betterMinReputation; not set (design: not stated)

shareByKind.description: Share of basic + better a market stocks, by market kind; design draft city 0.6, town 0.4

betterMinReputation.description: Reputation with the Krug needed for the better items, design draft 20
